description: Beginning at the clubhouse on South Green Lake Road, visitors can explore over 150km of snowmobile trails. Most of the marked route is along older logging roads, although connector trails have been cut to link road systems.
directions: From Clinton, travel along Hwy 97 to 70 Mile House. At 70 Mile turn east onto North Bonarparte Road. Travel 10km then turn north onto South Green Lake Road. Follow the road for approximately 2 km to the Green Lake Snowmobile Club Parking Lot.

stats.Activity Details: Four Wheel Driving, Trail Bike Riding - Motorized, Snowmobiling

title: Green Lake Snowmobile Trails
